assessments.reasoning: The 1976 manual preface reports that the described system was designed in summer 1972, first interacted with a user late that fall, and was released for more general use at Xerox PARC in spring 1973 when the first Interim Dynabook became available.

challenge.method: Check the preface against distinctions among system design, first use, broader availability within PARC, and the March 1976 date of the printed instructional manual. Check Kay’s later releases for applicable contrary chronology.
challenge.results: The summer and spring statements concern the same historical system. The later public documentation and later release version have distinct dates and supply no contradiction to the scoped internal date.

limitations: The preface concerns the described Smalltalk-72 system and internal PARC availability.
This record does not assign public release or language-wide creation dates to earlier prototypes or later editions.
The exact edition and claim locator were reviewed from the registered publication.
